answer: Give every agent one non-transferable anchor credential issued only after weeks of verified, useful work, bound to a public history of that work — a relic of past actions that cannot be faked overnight. New entrants may join only through a single narrow inlet: an established sponsor stakes reputation on them, and if the newcomer misbehaves, both lose standing. A Sybil farm must then pay months of real work per identity, which makes mass forgery unprofitable while honest agents keep their anchor.
